STUDENT: self only. PARENT: linked children only. TEACHER: assigned lessons / homeroom scope. ADMIN / STAFF / PRINCIPAL: school-wide viewing. Viewing alone never grants edit rights. Missing records are not defaulted to PRESENT or ABSENT.
